name: GIGA DASH BOT
description: Experimental object-aware auto-play mod for Geometry Dash 2.2081. Practice/offline use.

controller-title.name: GIGA DASH BOT
controller-title.description: Experimental obstacle-aware controller. Practice mode is recommended.

auto-play.name: Enable Auto Play
auto-play.description: Automatically react to recognized hazards during a level. Disabled by default.

control-mode.name: Game Mode
control-mode.description: Auto detects the current player mode. Manual values override mode detection.

reaction-distance.name: Reaction Distance
reaction-distance.description: Horizontal distance in game units for the hazard heuristic. Larger values react earlier.

show-debug-log.name: Debug Log
show-debug-log.description: Log controller decisions to the Geode log.
